newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Italian President Scalfaro to visit Morocco.
newsitem.headline: Italian President Scalfaro to visit Morocco.

text.p: Italian President Oscar Luigi Scalfaro will pay a three-day official visit to Morocco starting on March 18, the official Moroccan news agency MAP said on Thursday.
Scalfaro's visit follows an invitation from King Hassan, said MAP, quoting a royal palace statement. It gave no other details.
The announcement of the visit came less than two weeks after Morocco's Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali paid a 48-hour visit to Italy, accompanied by ministers and businessmen.
